_comment: Skills in skills/manifest.json deliberately NOT bundled into openclaw.plugin.json (Tier B: host-repo only). This file is the machine-readable curation record: test/openclaw-plugin-manifest.test.ts asserts manifest = plugin + exclusions with no overlap. Removing a line here requires adding the slug to openclaw.plugin.json in the same commit (and vice versa). Seeded 2026-08-11 from the pre-wave state; each entry is a recorded decision, not an accident.

exclusions.migrate: host-side data-migration workflows; not useful to a downstream plugin install
exclusions.setup: host install/provisioning flow; plugin installs arrive already set up
exclusions.schema-author: schema-pack authoring is a brain-owner activity, not a client activity
exclusions.schema-unify: schema unification is a brain-owner migration activity
exclusions.skill-optimizer: requires host-side skillopt engine access and benchmark files
exclusions.db-repair: host-side database access repair (engine-free CLI ladder); downstream openclaw clients do not own the DB
exclusions.postgres-adopt: host-side engine detection/adoption (init ladder + engine migration); downstream openclaw clients do not own the engine
